preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 100000 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isalpha() for c in line)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all('a' <= c <= 't' for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line)])
preconditions.description: Strings A and B consist only of the first 20 lowercase English letters (a-t).

preconditions.expression: len([line.strip() for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line)]) == 2 * t
preconditions.description: There are exactly 2*t lines containing strings A and B for the t test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == len(B) for A, B in zip([line.strip() for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line)][::2], [line.strip() for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line)][1::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, strings A and B have the same length n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() == '-1' or (line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) >= 0) for line in stdout_text.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either -1 or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of moves.

postconditions.expression: all((any(A[i] != B[i] for i in range(len(A))) and (any(A[i] != B[i] for i in range(len(A))) and (lambda: -1 if any(A[i] != B[i] and A[i] == B[i] for i in range(len(A))) else (lambda: -1 if any(A[i] != B[i] for i in range(len(A))) else 0)()) == int(line.strip()) if line.strip() != '-1' else True) for line, (A, B) in zip(stdout_text.strip().splitlines(), zip([line.strip() for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line)][::2], [line.strip() for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line)][1::2])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the output is not -1, it equals the minimum number of moves required to transform A into B using the allowed operations; if impossible, the output is -1.
